newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat falls further as Refco sells 4.0 mln bu.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat falls further as Refco sells 4.0 mln bu.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures fell further near midday as Refco Inc sold at least four million bushels of July, traders said.
The market had labored through the morning on forecasts for rain in dry wheat areas of Kansas and Nebraska, they said.
"Refco sold four million and commercials were scale down buyers. Commission houses were selling it," a trader said.
Meteorologists said rain was forecast for dry northwest Kansas late Thursday and Friday.
The market was underpinned by firm cash basis markets and slow farmer selling, the traders said.
"Mills are hand to mouth and would like to see some harvest activity," the trader said.
At 1150 CDT, KCBT hard red winter wheat futures were one to six cents per bushel lower, with July down 5-3/4 at $4.08.
